description: Charis Hebrew transliteration — revised Michigan/Claremont, ASCII-friendly. Maps Hebrew consonants to ASCII. Reconstructed 2026-07-24 from committed examples (RA$'+ = rashit/ראשית, ALH'M = elohim/אלהים, YHWH) plus standard Michigan/Claremont; ratified by user 2026-07-24 (tet/taw collision resolved: taw keeps attested '+', tet takes '9'). confidence marks provenance: 'attested' = from committed examples; 'standard' = unrevised M/C; 'inferred' = revision chosen at ratification.
note: Vowel points and cantillation are dropped; consonantal skeleton only. Final forms map to the same letter as medial.

letters.name: alef
letters.evidence: RA$'+ (ראשית), ALH'M (אלהים); standard M/C uses ')' — this is the revision

letters.name: het
letters.evidence: M/C uses X; README notes multiple 'H'-ish letters need distinct ASCII

letters.name: tet
letters.evidence: Ratified 2026-07-24: standard M/C '+' was reassigned to taw by the Charis revision (attested RA$'+); tet takes '9' (glyph resembles ט).

letters.name: yod
letters.evidence: ALH'M (אלהים), RA$'+ (ראשית); standard M/C uses 'Y' — this is the revision

letters.name: ayin
letters.evidence: M/C value '('; no committed Charis example. May want an ASCII-friendlier revision (e.g. 'O' or '`').

letters.name: taw
letters.evidence: RA$'+ (ראשית ends in ת); collision with standard-M/C tet resolved at ratification — tet moved to '9'
